contract: Strict integer JSON ingress through validated wiring, codecs, Adapter and supervised volatile Units with neutral outer DeliveryResults in fused or hop placement.
limits: Volatile, unbounded history/mailbox, not durable or exactly-once and not a complete old Zoo receiver.
Hop partial failure can consume a dedup key without accumulating; no atomicity.
Pipeline call is Adapter/Host entry, not fused-edge traversal; ingress is an internal transition seam checked on behalf of pipeline/ingress.request.
Equivalence only for named crash-free traces, not general call-versus-hop equivalence.
Upstream OTP crash reports may log last request/state under consumer Logger configuration; Boundary emits no payload, exception or Jason error data in errors or logs.

grounding.claim: Named finite executable scenarios, not universal proofs.
